name: Fjords

categories.label: Vikings placed (incl. uncontested tiles)
categories.labelVi: Số Viking đã đặt (kể cả ô không ai tranh)
categories.hint: 1 point per viking placed in the settlement phase; longhouses do not score. Uncontested tiles you could not fill because you ran out count as yours.

categories.label: Rune: vikings next to Strength rune
categories.labelVi: Rune Sức mạnh: viking kề rune
categories.hint: +1 per viking on a tile adjacent to the Strength (Thor) rune.

categories.label: Rune: vikings on Water rune region
categories.labelVi: Rune Nước: viking trên vùng nước
categories.hint: +1 per viking on a tile showing the water region that holds the Water rune.

categories.label: Rune: vikings next to your Home rune
categories.labelVi: Rune Nhà: viking kề rune nhà
categories.hint: +1 per own viking adjacent to your Home rune (opponents get nothing).

categories.label: Rune: Friendship runes where you lead
categories.labelVi: Rune Hữu nghị: số rune bạn dẫn đầu
categories.hint: 2 points for each Friendship rune with you holding the most adjacent vikings (ties all score 2).

tiebreakers.description: Rulebook: on a tie you may play another round and add scores together.

notes: family: area-majority. Score = vikings placed. Epic 2-player variant (extra colour) counts both colours as yours. Classic variant: play three games and add scores (use one file per game total or sum manually). Journey, Horse, Wisdom runes only change movement, not scoring; Secret rune is not in this copy.

sources.title: Fjords rulebook (Grail Games, 2022)
sources.section: p.5 Winning the game; pp.6-7 rune stone scoring; Classic and Epic variants
